tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bden bzhi dang rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag tshig gi sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /kun 'byung sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras kun/ /lam bden bad
༄༅/ /bden bzhi dang rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag tshig gi sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /kun 'byung sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras kun/ /lam bden bad

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bden bzhi dang rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag tshig gi sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /kun 'byung sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras kun/ /lam bden bdud rtsis spangs pa las/ /'gogs pa 'chi med grub pa'i dbyid/ /ston pa mchog des dge legs mdzod/ /'di la gsum ste/ bden bzhi dang rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag /'chi 'pho ji ltar byed pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la'ang*/ grangs nges/ go rim/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ rgyud gang la yod med/ rnam pa sgrub tshul/ sgra don/ dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thar 'dod kyi skyes bus gtan la dbab bya dang*/ 'jug ldog gi gtso bo la bden pa bzhir grangs nges te/ 'khor bar 'jug pa'i rgyu kun 'byung*/ 'bras bu sdug bden/ ldog pa'i rgyu lam bden dang*/ bral 'bras 'gog bden gnyis su nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde du mar bden bzhi ston pa'i go rim gnyis su gsungs te/ de yang rgyu 'bras don gyi rim pa'i dbang du byas na/ dang por kun 'byung*/ de nas lam/ sdug bsngal/ 'gog bden bstan la/ mngon rtogs skye ba'i rim pa'i dbang du byas na/ sdug kun 'gogs lam gyi bden pa bzhi rim can du bstan pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas te bshad na/ rim pa de ltar bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ bden bzhi'i blang dor la 'jug pa'i tshe/ thog mar rang gzhan rnams skye rga na 'chi sogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir tshul shes pas de spang 'dod kyi blo bskyed dgos pa'i phyir sdug bden dus dang por bstan/ de nas de gang las byung na chags sogs nyon mongs kyi las kyi kun 'byung las byung bar shes nas de spang 'dod bskyed dgos pas kun 'byung*/ de rjes sdug kun gnyis spangs pa'i 'gog bden thar pa la thob 'dod kyi blo bskyed dgos pas 'gogs bden/ de nas thar pa de thob pa'i thabs bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs lam bden rang rgyud la bsten dgos pas lam bden dus bzhi par bstan pa ste/

de yang dper na/ dang po rang cag lta bu nad kyis gdungs pa'i sdug bsngal de shes dgos/ de shes na de'i rgyu spang 'dod skye la/ de skyes na nad kyi sdug bsngal de dang bral ba'i bde pa thob 'dod skye zhing*/ de'i ched du sman bsten pa la 'jug pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ rje btsun byams pas/ nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la/ /bder gnas thob bya sman ni bsten par bya ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam/ /shes bya spang bya rig par bya zhing bsten par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu 'bras don gyi rim pa'i dbang du byas na/ nyon mongs phyogs kyis kun 'byung las sdug bden 'byung ni/ rnam byang gi phyogs kyi lam bden las 'gogs bden thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ mtshan gzhi la mi mthun pa cher med kyang*/ mtshan nyid bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba mang na'ang*/ 'dir go ba gtso bor byas na/ rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i kun 'byung bden pas lag rjes bzhag pa'i nyer len gyi phung po de sdug bden gyi mtshan nyid/ de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ lus la tshor ba drag pos gzir ba'i gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal lta bu sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ zas bzang po'i rol sred nas tshor ba nyams su bde ba lta bu 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ las nyon gyi lag rjes bzhag pa'i phung po lnga lta bu khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum dang*/ gzhan yang 'dod khams kyi gnas 'di lta bu dang ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten dang*/ rang cag lta bu'i so skyes ma dag pa'i bcud kyi sems can gnyis/ gzhan yang dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs kyis gzhi lta bu 2/ nyer 1len gyi phung po lnga lta 2bu/ der gyur pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu 1dang*/ bdag po'i 'bras 2bu 6/ yang myong tshul gyis dbye na/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang*/ dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad kyis dogs pa'i/

gnyen sdug pa dang bral gyis dogs pa'i/ 'dod pa btsal kyang mi rnyed pa'i/ gnas ngan len gyi sdug bsngal dang brgyad yod/ rang 'brus sdug bsngal bden pa skyed byed kyi rigs su gnas pa'i nyer len gyi phung po de kun 'byung bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na nyon mongs dang*/ las dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i kun 'byung gsum/ dang po ni/ der gyur pa'i rtsa nyon drug

'dod khro nga rgyal ma rig the tshom lta ba dang*/ nye nyon nyi shu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa'i bde 'gror 'phen byed srog gcod spangs pa'i las dang*/ sbyin pa byin pa'i zag bcas kyi las lta bu/ der gyur pa'i bsod nams kyi/ ngan 'gror 'phen byed/ /srog gcod dang ma byin len lta bu bsod nams ma yin pa'i/ gzugs dang gzugs med kyi lhar skye ba 'phen byed kyi las bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi bsgom pa lta bu mi g.yo ba'i las te gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs dang las kyi kun 'byung mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i gtso sems lta bu'o/ /yang las kyi kun 'byung la dbye na/ der gyur pa'i sgo gsum gyi las dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi las rnams su yod/ rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur pa'i lam bden gyi bral ba'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i so sor brtags 'gog 'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid de la sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa'am/ brdar brtags pa'i 'gog pa/ don dam pa'i 'gog pa/ de bzhin du rgyan bcas rgyan med/ lhag bcas lhag med/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i 'gog pa rnams su yod/ dang po ni/ sbyor lam rtse mo pa'i rgyud kyi khong khros dge rtsa gcod pa spangs pa'i cha dang*/ sbyor lam bzod pa nas ngan 'gror skye ba spangs pa'i cha dang*/ so skye'i rgyud kyi 'dod pa'i nyon mongs mngon gyur pa la re zhig chags pa dang bral ba'i cha dang*/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam pa'i rgyud kyi bden 'dzin kun brtags 'gog pa'i cha lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa dang 'gog bden don gcig /gsum pa ni/ mngon shes drug thob pa'i dgra bcom gyi rgyud kyi 'gog bden lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ mngon shes ma thob pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi 'gog bden lta bu/ lnga pa dang drug pa ni nyer len gyi phung po dang bcas ma bcas sam/

thal 'gyur ba ltar na bden snang gi lhag ma dang bcas ma bcas kyi myang 'das gnyis/ bdun pa ni slob pa dang*/ brgyad pa mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden no/ /rang gi bral 'bras su phyur pa'i 'gog bden gyi bral rgyu byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa lam bden gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dngos brtags ma phye bar dbye na/ tshogs lam sogs lnga/ ngo bo'i sgo nas theg gsum 'phags rgyud kyi lam bden gsum du dbye'o/ /'gog lam gnyis ji ltar thob tshul ni/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya kun brtags dang lhan skyes gang dngos su spong ba'i gnyen po byed pa'i 'phags pa'i ye shes kun gyis kyang rang gis dngos su 'thob par 'gyur ba'i 'gog bden rnams kyi bral rgyu byas nas/ nam ye shes de dag gis rang rang gis spang bya de rnams dngos su spangs pa de'i tshe/ spang bya de shes rgyud kyi steng du slar mi skye ba'i tshul gyis spangs pa'i tshe thob par 'gyur bas/ de la ni 'gog bden zhes bya zhing*/ de dang mnyam pa'i rnam grol rnams kyang 'gog bden gyi bral rgyu byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i lam bden du 'jog pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ sdug kun gnyis so skye'i rgyud la yod pa gtso che zhing*/ 'gog lam gnyis 'phags rgyud kho na la yod/ ma dag pa'i zhing sdug bden yin kyang dag pa'i zhing min par gsungs pas/ bde ba can dang de'i so skye rnams ni sdug bden min la/ de las gzhan pa'i so skye rnams dang*/ de'i nyer len phung po dang de dag gi rgyud kyi las nyon rnams ni sdug kun ci rigs su nges/ theg dman 'phags pa'i rgyud la nyer len gyi phung po yod pas/ sdug bden dang las kyi kun 'byung gnyis ka yod kyang*/ theg chen 'phags rgyud la sdug kun gnyis ka med pas de'i rgyud kyi las dang nyon mongs rnams dang kun 'byung min no/ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal khams gsum kar yod/

gzhan gnyis 'dod khams ma gtogs med do/ /lnga pa ni/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug yod pa las/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i rnam pa mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med bzhi ste/ nyer len gyi phung po chos can/ mi rtag pa'i rnam pa yin te/ res 'ga' skye ba'i phyir/ sdug bsngal ba yin te/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ don gzhan gyis stong ste/ dbang sgyur ba po'i bdag po'i don gzhan gyis stong pa'i phyir/ bdag med pa'i rnam pa yin te/ rang dbang pa'i bdag ma grub pa'i phyir/ de ltar dran cing bsgoms pas rim bzhin nyer len gyi phung po la rtag /bde/ gtsang ba/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i phyin ci log bzhi spong bar byed do/ /kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam par rgyu kun 'byung rab skye rkyen bzhi ste/ zag bcas kyi las nyon gnyis chos can/ rgyu'i rnam pa yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung ba= rang 'bras sdug bsngal kun yang yang bskyed pa'i phyir/ rab skye= sdug bsngal de shugs drag tu bskyed pa'i phyir/ rkyen gyi rnam pa= rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi lhan cig byed rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar bsgoms pas rim bzhin sdug bsngal rgyu med du/ de rgyu gcig kho nas byas par/ de dbang phyug sogs kyis byas par/ de'ang bzhin gyis rtag la gnas skabs 'gyur bar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rnams spong bar byed/ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa la 'gog zhi gya nom nges 'byung bzhi ste/ sdug kun gtan nas spangs pa'i bral ba chos can/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa yin te/ sdug bsngal spangs pa'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhi ba= nyon mongs spangs pa'i bral ba yin pa'i= gya nom pa yin te/ phan bde'i dngos por gyur pa'i thar pa yin pa'i= nges 'byung = slar mi ldog pa'i thar pa= de ltar bsgoms pas rim bzhin/ thar pa ye med du/ zag bcas kyi khyad par 'ga' zhig thar par/

sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin 'ba' zhig thar par/ thar pa yod kyang slar ldog par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rnams spong bar byed/ lam bden gyi rnam pa la lam sgrub pa rig pa nges 'byin bzhi ste/ bdag med kyi don mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes chos can/ lam gyi rnam pa yin te/ thar par bgrod byed kyi lam dngos sam der gtogs kyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa yin te/ bdag med ci rigs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes= rig pa= nyon mongs kyi gnyen po byed pa'i= nges phyin gyi rnam pa= sdug bsngal slar mi ldog par byed pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar bsgoms pas rim bzhin thar lam ye med du 'dzin pa/ bsam gtan gyi ngo bo 'ga' zhig thar lam du/ zag bcas kyi khyad par 'ga' zhig thar lam du/ sdug bsngal gtan zad pa'i thar lam med par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rnams spong bar byed do/ /drug pa ni/ bzhi po de dag la 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de rnams 'phags pa rnams kyis gzigs pa ltar bden cing*/ byis pa so skyes bzung ba ltar mi bden pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ bdun pa ni/ bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag ni theg pa che chung kun tu lan du mang gsungs shing*/ 'khor bar 'jug ldog gi gnad rnams thams cad mkhyen pas bsdus pa yin pas rnam grol bsgrub pa la shin tu gal che zhing*/ nyams len gyi 'gags sdom yang che bas rim pa de ltar du slob dgos pa'i phyir dgos pa shin tu che par grub bo/ /gnyis pa rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa la bdun/ spyi'i mtshan nyid/ so so'i dbye ba/ bsdu ba/ byed las tshe du la rdzogs/ bsgom tshul/ bsgoms pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ sā lu ljang pa'i mdo las bstan don rten 'brel mdo 'grel sogs las rgyas par bshad pa ltar/ de dag gi dngos bstan ni 'dus byas rten 'brel gyi dbang du byas la/

spyir ltos nas grub pa rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi rgyu rkyen la ltos nas grub pa/ 'dus byas rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar du bcu gnyis te/ dang po ma rig pa la/ spyir las 'bras dang*/ de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa gnyis su yod la/ snga mas ni ngan 'gro dang*/ phyi mas ni bde 'gro ngan 'gro gnyis kar 'phen pa'i las gsog /de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ni/ thal rang gnyis kas bden 'dzin thams cad la byed kyang thal 'gyur bas bden 'dzin yin na ma rig pas khyab ces bzhed pa dang*/ rang rgyud pas ni de ltar mi bzhed/ rang rgyud pa man chad kyi rang sde ltar na/ gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rnams ni/ ma rig pa yin pas thal rang gnyis kyi lugs la 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'dra'o/ /gang ltar na'ang rang rang lugs kyi bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi don la rmongs pa'i so skye'i rgyud kyi de 'dra'i ma rig pa de 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin par bzhed pa ni 'dra'o/ /des na yan lag bcu gnyis kyi thog ma'i ma rig pa dang bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ste/ 'di la kun brtags dang lhan skyes gnyis ka yod par bshad kyang*/ 'phags pa'i rgyud la ni/ yan lag bcu gnyis kyi thog mar gyur pa'i ma rig pa med do/ /mkhas pa phal cher 'du byed kyi las kyi rgyu'i kun slong gi ma rig pa la ni las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa mi srid ces bzhed snang yang*/ dus kyi kun slong la ni de yod do/ /gnyis pa 'du byed la ni las yin la/ de la'ang bsod nams ma yin pa/ bsod nams/ mi g.yo ba'i las te gsum mo/ /gsum pa rnam shes ni/ mdo las/ tshogs drug tu gsungs kyang 'dir gtso bo'i dbang du byas na yid shes te/ de la dge mi dge'i las bsags pa'i bag chags bsgos pa'i tshe 'di'i rnam shes ni rgyu dus kyi rnam shes yin la/

phyi mar skye gnas su nying mtshams sbyar ba na 'bras dus kyi rnam shes su 'gyur bas/ gnyis ka la rnam shes kyi rten 'brel zhes gcig tu bgrang pa'o/ /bzhi pa ming gzugs kyi ming ni/ tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes te gzugs can ma yin pa'i ming gzhi'i phung po dang*/ gzugs ni mer mer po la sogs pa ste/ gzugs med du skye na gzugs kyi sa bon tsam las gzugs ni med do/ /lnga pa skye mched drug ni/ mngal du skye na/ dang por rnam shes khu khrag gi mer mer po dang ming rnams 'phel nas grub pa'i mig dang rna ba la sogs pa'i skye mched rnams te/ lus dang yid kyi skye mched ni sngar nas yod do/ /brdzus te skyes na rdzus skyes dbang po rnams gcig car du 'grub pas rim pa de ltar med la/ sgong dang drod skyes la ni mngal ma gtogs cha 'dra bar bshad/ drug pa reg pa ni/ yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus pa la brten nas yul gzugs sogs yid du 'ong mi 'ong bar ma gsum/ gang rung yongs su gcod pa'i sems byung dang po grub pa ste/ 'di la mig nas yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i bar ci rigs yod do/ /bdun pa tshor ba ni/ reg pas yul gsum gang rung bcad pa dang rjes su mthun par/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum gang rung skyes pa'o/ /'di la'ang sngar bzhin yod/ brgyad pa sred pa ni/ tshor ba bde ba la ni mi 'bral ba dang sdug bsngal la 'bral 'dod kyi sred pa'am/ btang snyoms gang rung la sred pa gang rung ste/ 'di la 'dod sred/ srid sred/ 'jig sred gsum/ dgu pa len pa ni/ sred pa de nyid cher 'phel ba'i 'dod chags te/ 'di la 'dod pa nye bar len pa/ lta ba/ brtul zhugs/ bdag tu smra ba'i nyer len bzhi/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs 'dod yon la chags pa/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jig lta ma yin pa'i lta ngan la chags pa/ gsum pa ni/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs dman la chags pa/

bzhi pa ni/ 'jig lta la 'dun zhing chags pa'i sred pa/ bcu pa srid pa ni/ sngar 'du byed kyi las kyi bag chags rnam shes la bsgos pa de nyid sred len gnyis kyis gsos btab nas yang srid phyi ma 'dren pa nus mthu can du song ba'i skabs kyi las te/ srid pa zhes pa ni 'bras ming rgya la btags pa'o/ /'di la khams gsum gyi las gsum/ bcu gcig pa skye ba ni/ srid las kyi mthus skye gnas bzhi po gang rung du rnam shes dang por nying mtshams sbyang ba de/ 'di la mngal du nying mtshams sbyar ba sogs bzhi'am/ khams gsum gyi nying mtshams sbyang ba gsum/ 'di'i skye ba nying mtshams sbyar ma thag pa'i gnas skabs kyi phung po lnga dang*/ kha cig mngal nas phyi rol du btsa' ba la de 'jog mod/ 'dir ni nying mtshams sbyar ba'i cha dang por 'dod do/ /bcu gnyis pa rga shi la/ rga ba ni phung po smin cing gzhan du 'gyur ba'i cha yin la/ shi ba ni phung po ris mthun pa 'dor ba'am dor ba'o/ /de gnyis yan lag gcig tu 'jog pa ni/ de gnyis go rim ma nges pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa la sogs pa ni yan lag tu 'gyur bar ma nges par zhar byung tsam ste skyo ba bskyed pa'i ched du gsungs so/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ mdor bsdu ba dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ yan lag bcu gnyis po de rgyu 'bras kyis bsdus te/ 'phen byed dang*/ 'grub byed kyi rgyu 'bras gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ de yang ma rig pa/ 'du byed/ rgyu dus kyi rnam shes gsum ni/ 'phen byed kyi rgyu dang*/ 'bras dus kyi rnam shes dang ming gzugs skye mched drug /reg pa chor ba ste phyed dang lnga ni 'phangs pa'i 'bras bu dang*/ sred len srid pa gsum 'grub byed kyi rgyu dang*/ skye rga gnyis ni/ grub pa'i 'bras bu'i yan lag tu 'du'o/ /gang 'phang na/ 'bras dus ni rnam shes nas tshor ba'i bar yan lag phyed lnga'o/

/gang gis 'phangs na/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed kyi las kyis so/ /ji ltar 'phangs na rgyu dus kyi rnam shes la las kyi bag chags bsgos pa'i tshul gyis so/ /'phangs pa'i don ni/ sred pa sogs 'grub byed yod na 'bras bu de rnams 'grub rung du byas pa'o/ /gang gis 'grub par byed na srid pa'i rkyen gyi len pas so/ /gang 'grub na skye ba dang rga shi'o/ /ji ltar 'grub par byed ce na/ 'du byed kyis rnam shes la bsgos pa'i las kyi bag chags des nus mthu can du byas pa'i tshul gyis so/ /des na 'di'i 'phangs pa'i yan lag dang grub pa'i yan lag don gnyis ngo bo gcig go /gnyis pa ni/ ma rig sred len gsum nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung*/ 'du byed dang srid las gnyis las kyi kun 'byung 'bras dus kyi rnam shes sogs bdun ni sdug bden du 'du'o/ /bzhi pa byed las ni/ ma rig pas de kho na nyid la sgrib/ 'du byed kyis yang srid phyi ma'i sa bon 'debs/ rnam shes kyis skye gnas su 'khrid/ ming gzugs kyis lus 'dzin/ skye mched kyis lus rdzogs/ reg pas yul gyi 'gyur ba spyod/ tshor bas rnam smin spyod/ sred pas phung po slar sdud/ len pas phung po 'grub pa la sbyor/ srid pas phyi ma'i phung po mngon du 'gyur/ skye ba dang rga shis rang rang gar la ldan pa'i gang zag de sdug bsngal bar byed do/ /lnga pa ni/ myur na tshe gnyis dang*/ bul na gsum gyis rdzogs la/ kha cig tshe bzhir rdzogs pa'ang yod ces gsungs/ dang po skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi dbang du byas pa ste/ dper na mi 'ga' zhig ma rig pas kun nas bslangs te/ rgyu dus kyi rnam shes kyis 'dod lhar skye ba'i 'du byed kyi las bsags/ las de 'chi ka tshun sred len gnyis kyis gsos btab nas srid las nus ldan du byas te skye ba blangs na tshe snga mar phyed drug /phyi ma lhar bskyed pa'i tshe 'bras dus kyi rnam shes sogs phyed bdun 'grub par 'gyur bas so/

/gnyis pa ni/ lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi dbang du byas pa ste/ dper na mi zhig gis rten de yang ma rig pa'i stobs kyis rnam shes kyi steng du las kyi bag chags bzhag pas de la sred len gnyis kyis gsos ma btab par dud 'gror skyes/ rten de la sred len gnyis kyis gsos btab nas srid las nus pa can du byas nas 'dod lhar skyes kyi skye ba blangs pa'i tshe/ yan lag dang po gnyis tshe dang po/ srid len srid pa gsum gnyis pa/ lhag ma rnams tshe gsum pa la rdzogs pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa slar len na ni sred pas gsos btab kyang*/ len pas gsos ma btab pa zhig 'dod dgos so/ /'di dag ni theg pa chen po'i dbang du byas pa ste/ mdo sde dang*/ /bye smra ba'i lugs cung zad mi 'dra pa yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ yan lag dang por rig pa 'khor rtsar 'gyur tshul spyi dang*/ khyad par de'i rkyen gyis 'du byed 'byung ba nas/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi 'byung ba'i bar ni nyon mongs phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs mthun dang*/ rga shi gang nas 'byung na skye ba las 'byung ba nas/ 'du byed ma rig pa las 'byung ba'i bar ni nyon mongs pa'i phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs ldog /ma rig pa 'gag pa nas 'du byed 'gags nas/ skye ba 'gags pa nas rga shi 'gags pa'i bar rnam byang phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs mthun dang*/ gang 'gags pas rga shi 'gag snyam na/ skye bu 'gags pas rga shi 'gags so zhes pa nas/ ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gags pa'i bar ni rnam byang phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs ldog tu bsgom par bya'o/ /de la'ang dang po gnyis ltar bsam pa ni/ rim bzhin sdug kun gnyis shes par byed pa yin la/ phyi ma gnyis ltar bsam pa ni/ 'gog lam gnyis sgom par byed pa yin no/ /bdun pa ni/ 'phags pa klus/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi/ /gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste/

/gang gis 'di ni yang dag mthong ba des/ /sangs rgyas de nyid rig pa rnams mchog mthong*/ /zhes sogs phan yon dpag tu med do/ /gsum pa 'chi 'pho ji ltar byed tshul la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ zhar byung ngo*/ /dang po la lnga/ 'chi ba'i rkyen/ 'chi ba'i sems/ drod sdud tshul/ bar do 'grub lugs/ skye srid du nyid mtshams sbyor tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ tshe zad nas dus kyis 'chi ba dang*/ ma zad kyang dus min gyi 'chi ba'o/ /phyi ma la'ang*/ bsod nams zad nas nad sogs kyis 'chi ba dang*/ gzhan yang dus min gyi 'chi rkyen dgu mdo las gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi sems gsum ci rigs su 'byung la/ spyir dge ba byed pa rnams dge sems dang*/ mi dge ba byed pa rnams sdig pa byung mod/ dmigs bsal la ma nges shing*/ de dag 'du shes rags pa rgyu ba'i tshe yin phyi/ phra mo'i skabs su ni lung ma bstan gyi sems kho nar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ mi dge ba chen po byed pa rnams drod stod nas dang*/ dge ba chen po byed pa rnams kyi drod smad nas sdud la/ gnyis ka'ang drod snying ga'i bar bsdus te rnam shes 'pho'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rnam shes phyir 'pho ba dang bar chad med par srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin du bar do 'grub ste/ 'gro ba gang du skye bar 'gyur ba de'i lus dbyibs can du 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang gzugs med khams su skye ba'i tshe bar do med do/ /lnga pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ 'phros don no/ /dang po ni/ mngal du skye na/ bar do ba des rang dang ris mthun pa'i sems can dag mthong nas de dag la lta ba dang*/ rtse ba sogs byed la/ pha ma'i khu khrag la phyin ci log tu mthong pa'i blos de dang nye bar lhags pa na bud med de'i dbang po tsam zhig ma gtogs gzhan gang yang mi snang bar gyur pas khros te shi 'phos nas nying mtshams sbyor ro/ /nying mtshams sbyar ma thag gi rnam shes ni/

yid shes kho na ste gzhan ni de'i tshe med do/ /der mer mer po dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i 'byung ba cha phra ba rnams dang 'dres nas rim gyis 'phel te/ zhag bdun phrag so brgyad lhag tsam nas phyir btsa' bar 'gyur te/ 'di dag gi rnam gzhag zhib pa ni dga' bo mngal 'jug gi mdo las rgyas par 'byung ngo*/ /dmyal ba phal cher dang dud 'gro dang yi dwags dang mi dang 'dod gzugs kyi lhar skye na ni/ rang dang ris mthun pa'i sems can mthong ste/ der song na skye gnas la khros pa'i rkyen gyis bar srid 'gags nas skye srid du nyid mtshams sbyor la/ 'on kyang lug dang phag dang bya ri dwags mang po gsod pa'i sdig can dmyal bar skye nges pa rnams la bar srid nas lug dang phag sogs de dag rmi lam bzhin du mthong nas sngon goms kyi dga' bas der rgyug go/ /de nas skye ba'i gnas la khros pas bar srid 'gags te skye srid du 'pho bar 'gyur ro/ sgor skyes ni phal cher mngal skyes dang 'dra zhing*/ drod gsher skye na dri dang*/ rdzus skyes kyis gnas 'dod cing*/ tsha dmyal du skye na drod dang*/ grang dmyal du skye na bsil bar 'dod pas rkyen byas nas nying mtshams sbyor bar bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma pa'i lugs kyi dbang du byas pa'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas 'khor bar 'khor tshul legs par shes dgos/ de yang phung po 'di nyid bdag ma yin la/ phung po 'di las don gzhan pa'i gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i bdag zhig 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba ma yin gyi/ phung po la brten btags pa'i nga tsam zhig sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rten 'brel bcu gnyis la brten pa'i tshul gyis kun rdzob tsam du 'khor bar 'khor ba'i tshul legs par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i tshe rnam shes 'di nyid 'di nas phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor tshul dang*/ de la dpe ci 'dra zhig yod ce na/ theg pa chen po'i lugs kyi rnam shes phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor tshul mdo las bshad pa'i don go sla bar brjod na/

bla mas slob mar/ na mo buddhā ya lta bu'i kha ton blo thog nas ngag gis bslab nas slob ma des blor bzung nas brjod tshe/ slob dpon gyi ngag slob ma la 'khos pa ma yin te/ yin na bla ma la slar de 'dra'i ngag brjod rgyu med par 'gyur ro/ /slob mas bla ma'i gsung la ma brten par byung ba'ang min te/ yin na rgyu med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dpe de bzhin shi nas phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor tshe 'chi ka'i rnam shes de nyid ngo bos 'gyur med du phyi ma'i rnam shes su 'pho ba yin te/ yin na de rtag par 'gyur bas skye ba len pa yang mi 'thad do/ /phyi ma'i rnam shes de 'chi ka'i rnam shes de la ma brten par mi 'byung ste/ 'byung na rgyu med par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na'ang bla mas brjod pa'i rgyu las slob ma'i ngag 'byung ba ltar snga ma'i rnam shes kyi rgyun las phyi ma'i rnam shes nyid 'byung la/ bla ma'i ngag dang slob ma'i ngag gcig tu mi rung ba bzhin tshe 'di'i 'chi ga ma'i rnam shes dang*/ phyi mar nying mtshams sbyar ba'i rnam shes gnyis gcig ma yin zhing*/ slob ma'i ngag de bla ma'i ngag thos pa las byung ba ltar/ phyi ma'i rnam shes yang snga ma'i rnam shes la brten nas byung ba yin gyi/ glo bur du gzhan byung ba'ang min no/ /de bzhin du mar me las mar me gnyis pa chad pa/ me long du byad 'char ba/ lha sku sogs spar gyi rgya las de 'dra'i ri mo 'byung ba/ me shel las me 'byung ba/ sa bon las myu gu 'byung ba/ shing tog sogs skyur mo mthong bas 'gram chu ldang ba dang*/ sgra grags pa las brag ca 'byung ba rnams la'ang sngar bshad pa'i rig pas sbyar bar bya'o/ /'chi 'pho tha snyad du yod kyang don dam par med par rtogs pas mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lam du grub pa yin pa bzhin 'dus byas thams cad kyi skye ba dang 'gag pa la'ang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa zhar byung ni/

bla med kyi lugs la bden 'dzin gyi ma rig pas 'khor ba mar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba byas te/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems tsam la brten nas btags pa'i nga nyid kyi steng du las kyi bag chags bsgos nas phyi mar skye ba rnams su nyid mtshams sbyor bar 'gyur ba yin te/ rdo rje phreng bar/ skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa dang*/ /srid pa bar mar gnas pa ste/ /ji srid 'jig rten gyis btags bas/ /sems ni rlung gi rnam 'phrul lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/
ces pa'ang nyer 'kho'i le'u tshan no/ /shu bhaṃ//
